parameters.content:
W35 Lead pulse (6B.2, 4.6 W35 row, FAQ-25). INACTIVE draft by conversation-designer for automation-engineer.
One question after an ATTENDED call: "was your call with {adviser} worth your time?" Yes, worth it / Not really (+ optional one line). Never about the advice; never shared with the broker by name; aggregate only (>= 5 answers). No reply -> nothing further.
Timing: attended mark + 30 min, never before the reach-check is settled (answered yes, or 2 h unanswered); reach-check 'no' -> no pulse; quiet hours 20:00-08:00 -> 08:00; stale after 48 h -> skipped.
Channel: inside the 24-h window (usually the reach-check tap) -> session buttons with LINES.PULSE_ASK (same words as the template minus STOP), lead's language; outside -> utility template lead_pulse (en).
Taps pulse_yes / pulse_no and the optional line arrive from W07 (Execute Workflow). Feeds: public.lead_pulse -> facts.fact_lead.lead_pulse / lead_pulse_thumbs; lead_activities 'lead_pulse' rows; W33 judge samples every 'down' (P.judgeHints); W14 broker report uses P.brokerLine.
Idempotency: the lead_pulse row (UNIQUE lead_id, booking_id) is claimed with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING before any send.
Logic: conversation/pulse.mjs. Tests: automation/tests/W35.test.mjs. Words: conversation/lines.mjs PULSE_*.

parameters.query:
SELECT o.booking_id, o.outcome, o.marked_at, o.lead_reach_check, o.cycle_id,
       l.id AS lead_id, l.first_name, l.language, l.opted_out_at, l.conv_state, l.phone, l.broker_id, l.brand_id,
       b.contact_person,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suppression s WHERE s.mobile_hash = public.smc_hash_contact(l.phone)) AS suppressed,
       (SELECT max(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'inbound') AS last_inbound_at,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'outbound') AS outbound_count,
       (SELECT min(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'outbound' AND c.template_name = 'reach_check' AND c.created_at >= o.marked_at - interval '6 hours') AS reach_sent_at,
       (SELECT min(c.created_at) FROM public.communications c WHERE c.lead_id = l.id AND c.direction = 'inbound' AND c.created_at >= o.marked_at - interval '6 hours' AND c.content ILIKE 'Yes, we spoke%') AS reach_answered_at
  FROM public.outcomes o
  JOIN public.leads l ON l.id = o.lead_id
  JOIN public.brokers b ON b.id = l.broker_id
 WHERE o.brand_id IS NOT NULL
   AND o.outcome = 'attended'
   AND o.marked_at > now() - interval '48 hours'
   AND l.opted_out_at IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.lead_pulse p WHERE p.lead_id = o.lead_id AND p.booking_id = o.booking_id)
 ORDER BY o.marked_at
 LIMIT 200;

INSERT INTO public.lead_pulse (lead_id, booking_id, broker_id, cycle_id, brand_id, sent_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, $5::uuid, now())
ON CONFLICT (lead_id, booking_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Execute Workflow Trigger (W07: pulse tap / pulse line)

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  UPDATE public.lead_pulse
     SET thumbs = COALESCE($3, thumbs), answered_at = COALESCE($4::timestamptz, answered_at), line = COALESCE($5, line), updated_at = now()
   WHERE lead_id = $1::uuid AND booking_id = $2::uuid
  RETURNING lead_id
)
UPDATE public.leads SET conv_state = $6::jsonb, updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1::uuid AND opted_out_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM p);
